official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 霅溪
cross_references.definition: 河川名。在浙江省吳興縣治南。苕溪、前溪、餘不溪、宵溪會合後方稱為「霅溪」，東北流入太湖。

official_dictionary.title: 暵
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
乾燥、乾涸。《說文解字．日部》：「暵，乾也。」
[動]
晒乾、曝晒。《廣韻．上聲．旱韻》：「暵，日乾也。」金．麻九疇〈許方村即事〉詩：「山雲頃刻雨，沙地須庾暵。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

踦.definition: the shin; to pierce; to touch

official_dictionary.title: 踦
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
腿、腳脛。唐．元稹〈蜘蛛詩．序〉：「巴蜘蛛，大而毒。其甚者，身邊數寸，而踦長數倍其身。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 踦
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
傾斜不平。通「崎」。《文選．左思．魏都賦》：「山阜猥積而踦𨄅。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 踦
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
刺、觸、頂住。《莊子．養生主》：「足之所履，膝之所踦，砉然嚮然，奏刀騞然，莫不中音。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

踣.definition: to stumble and fall prone; stiff in death

official_dictionary.title: 踣
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.跌倒。如：「踣地不起」。《聊齋志異．卷一．勞山道士》：「頭觸硬壁，驀然而踣。」
2.倒斃。《國語．魯語上》：「紂踣于京。」
3.暴屍。《周禮．秋官．掌戮》：「凡殺人者踣諸市，肆之三日。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蝘
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
蟬。《詩經．大雅．蕩》「如蜩如螗，如沸如羹」句下漢．毛亨．傳：「螗，蝘也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蝲
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蝲蛄」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蝲蛄
cross_references.definition: 動物名。一種蝦類。節肢動物門甲殼綱長尾類。形似龍蝦而小，多產於淡水，是肺吸蟲的中間宿主。前三對步足都有螯，第一對特別發達，略如蟹螯。為重要食用蝦，北美種類較多。

蝤.definition: grub, maggot; Scylla serrata, swimming crab

official_dictionary.title: 蝤
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蝤蛑」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蝤蛑
cross_references.definition: 梭子蟹的別名。參見「梭子蟹」條。

official_dictionary.title: 蝤
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.參見「蝤蠐」條。
2.一種昆蟲。通「蝣」。參見「蜉蝣」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蝤蠐
cross_references.definition: 天牛及桑牛的幼蟲。因其體豐潤潔白，故古人用以比喻婦女光滑柔膩的頸項。《詩經．衛風．碩人》：「膚如凝脂，領如蝤蠐。」

cross_references.title: 蝣
cross_references.definition: 參見「蜉蝣」條。

cross_references.title: 蜉蝣
cross_references.definition:
1.動物名。蟲類。長六、七分，頭似蜻蛉而略小，有四翅，體細而狹。夏秋之交，多近水而飛，往往數小時即死。也作「浮游」、「浮蝣」。
2.《詩經．曹風》的篇名。共三章。根據〈詩序〉：「蜉蝣，刺奢也。」首章二句為「蜉蝣之羽，衣裳楚楚。」

official_dictionary.title: 噇
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
大口吃喝。《儒林外史》第一一回：「在鎮上賭輸了，又噇了幾杯燒酒，噇的爛醉。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 噂
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
聚在一起說話。《說文解字．口部》：「噂，聚語也。」《詩經．小雅．十月之交》：「噂沓背憎，職競由人。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 噀
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
將水含在口中噴出去。泛指噴射。《後漢書．卷五七．欒巴傳》「所在有績，徵拜尚書」句下章懷太子注引《神仙傳》：「巴獨後到，又飲酒西南噀之。」元．喬吉〈水仙子．風吹絲雨噀窗紗〉曲：「風吹絲雨噀窗紗，苔和酥泥葬落花。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 噀
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 罶
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
捕魚的器具。《詩經．小雅．魚麗》：「魚麗于罶，鱨鯊。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

嶲.definition: a name of an old town in Sichuan; cuckoo; revolution of a wheel

official_dictionary.title: 嶓
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「嶓冢」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 嶓冢
cross_references.definition: 山名：(1)在陝西省寧羌縣北，東漢水的發源地。也稱為「嶓山」。(2)在甘肅省天水縣西南，西漢水的發源地。也稱為「兌山」。

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 嶟zūn 1.形容山石高峻尖锐。参见"嶟嶟"。

official_dictionary.title: 嶟
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
山勢高峻、陡峭。《集韻．平聲．魂韻》：「嶟，山高貌。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嶒
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「嶒稜」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 嶒稜
cross_references.definition: 高峻的樣子。宋．孫覿〈橫山堂〉詩：「波間指點見青紅，雪脊嶒稜倚半空。」也作「崚嶒」、「嶒崚」。

related_characters.definition: an ancient weapon resembling a pitchfork

official_dictionary.title: 稹
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
叢聚。《爾雅．釋言》：「苞，稹也。」晉．郭璞．注：「今人呼物叢緻者為稹。」宋．邢昺．疏：「物叢生曰苞，齊人名曰稹。」
[形]
緻密。通「縝」。《周禮．冬官考工記．輪人》：「陽也者，稹理而堅；陰也者，疏理而柔。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 儇
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
慧黠而輕薄。如：「儇薄」。《楚辭．屈原．九章．惜誦》：「忘儇媚以背眾兮，待明君其知之。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 皞
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
1.潔白光亮。《說文解字．日部》：「皞，皓旰也。」清．段玉裁．注：「皓旰，謂絜白光明之貌。」宋．楊澤民〈四園竹．殘霞殿雨〉詞：「殘霞殿雨，皞氣入窗扉。」
2.心胸舒暢。《孟子．盡心上》：「王者之民，皞皞如也。」明．余繼登《典故紀聞》卷二：「使民安田里，足衣食，熙熙皞皞而不自知。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 艎
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「艅艎」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 艅艎
cross_references.definition: 華麗的船。南朝梁．王籍〈入若耶溪〉詩：「艅艎何汎汎，空水共悠悠。」也作「艅皇」、「餘皇」。

official_dictionary.title: 艏
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
造船工程上指船首。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 鲪jūn 1.鱼类的一属。体狭长，侧扁，灰褐色，有不规则黑色斑纹。口大而斜。尾鳍圆形。卵胎生。生活于近海岩礁间。

觭.definition: one turning up and one turning down

official_dictionary.title: 觭
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.獸角一俯一仰的樣子。《說文解字．角部》：「觭，角一俛一仰也。」
2.單數。通「奇」。《莊子．天下》：「以堅白同異之辯相訾，以觭偶不仵之辭相應。」
[形]
單獨的。《漢書．卷二七．五行志中之下》：「遂要崤阨，以敗秦師，匹馬觭輪無反者，操之急矣。」唐．顏師古．注：「觭，隻也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 糇
official_dictionary.definition: 「餱」的異體字。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 糈
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.糧食。《說文解字．米部》：「糈，糧也。」如：「餉糈」。《史記．卷一二九．貨殖傳》：「醫方諸食技術之人，焦神極能，為重糈也。」
2.祭祀神的精米。《楚辭．屈原．離騷》：「巫咸將夕降兮，懷椒糈而要之。」《史記．卷一二七．褚少孫補．日者傳》：「夫卜而有不審，不見奪糈。」唐．司馬貞．索隱：「糈者，卜求神之米也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 翦
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.削減。《管子．任法》：「大臣能以其私附百姓，翦公財以祿私士。」
2.消滅、剷除。《詩經．魯頌．閟宮》：「居岐之陽，實始翦商。」《呂氏春秋．季夏紀．制樂》：「此文王之所以止殃翦妖也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 熛
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
火焰。《史記．卷九二．淮陰侯傳》：「天下之士雲合霧集，魚鱗雜遝，熛至風起。」《唐書．卷二二〇．東夷傳．高麗傳》：「士縱火焚西南，熛延城中，屋幾盡。」
[形]
迅速、疾速。如：「熛風」。
[副]
突然、驟然。如：「熛起」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

潖.definition: name of a place in Guangdong

㵐.definition: name of a river in Hubei Province, name of a state in ancient times

official_dictionary.title: 澂
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
澄清。同「澄」。《後漢書．卷七九．儒林傳．贊曰》：「千載不作，淵源誰澂？」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 潾
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
水清澈的樣子。唐．杜甫〈雜述〉：「泰山冥冥崒以高，泗水潾潾瀰以清。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 潏
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
水泉湧出。《說文解字．水部》：「潏，涌出也。」唐．岑參〈石犀〉詩：「江水初蕩潏，蜀人幾為魚。」
[名]
在水中填成的陸地。《爾雅．釋水》：「水中可居者曰洲，小洲曰渚，小渚曰沚，小沚曰坻，人所為為潏。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 戭
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
長槍。《說文解字．戈部》：「戭，長槍也。」《集韻．去聲．稕韻》：「戭，矛屬。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 戭
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
長戈。《集韻．上聲．準韻》：「戭，長戈。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

褯.definition: children's garments. a mat for wrapping garments

official_dictionary.title: 褯
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
包裹嬰兒的衣被。《廣韻．去聲．禡韻》：「褯，小兒席。」也作「裓」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嫽
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
遊戲、逗弄。《廣韻．平聲．蕭韻》：「嫽，相嫽戲也。」
[形]
美好。如：「嫽妙」、「嫽俏」。《文選．傅毅．舞賦》：「貌嫽妙以妖蠱兮，紅顏曄其揚華。」李善注引毛萇《詩傳》曰：「嫽，好貌。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 遹
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
遵循。《書經．康誥》：「今民將在祇遹乃文考，紹聞衣德言。」《資治通鑑．卷六八．漢紀六十．獻帝建安二十四年》：「繼以孝明、孝章，遹追先志，臨雍拜老，橫經問道。」
[助]
句首發語詞，無義。《詩經．大雅．文王有聲》：「遹求厥寧，遹觀厥成。」
[名]
姓。如宋代有遹復。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 璲
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
一種瑞玉。《詩經．小雅．大東》：「鞙鞙佩璲，不以其長。」漢．毛亨．傳：「璲，瑞也。」漢．鄭玄．箋：「佩璲者，以瑞玉為佩。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 憙
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
喜好、愛好。《穀梁傳．桓公六年》：「陳侯憙獵，淫獵于蔡，與蔡人爭禽。」《樂府詩集．卷二八．相和歌辭三．古辭．陌上桑》：「羅敷憙蠶桑，採桑城南隅。」
[名]
自得其樂的感覺。宋．陸游〈開東園路北至山腳因治路傍隙地雜植花草〉詩六首之四：「今朝有憙誰能識，不用人扶亦自行。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 擐
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
穿著。《左傳．成公二年》：「擐甲執兵，固即死也。」唐．韓愈〈崔十六少府攝伊陽以詩及書見投因酬三十韻〉：「上言酒味酸，冬衣竟未擐。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

鄹.definition: name of an ancient state in modern Shandong; surname

official_dictionary.title: 鄹
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

薳.definition: name of a herb; surname; (Cant.) a plant stem

鞔.definition: sides or uppers of shoes to stretch a skin on a frame for a drum; (Cant.) to cover

official_dictionary.title: 鞔
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
將皮革或布面框附固定在物體四周。如：「鞔鼓」、「鞔鞋」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鞔
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 薢
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 薢
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「薢茩」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 薢茩
cross_references.definition: 植物名。菱科菱屬，一年生浮水草本。根生土中，浮水葉略三角形，互生，葉柄長，中部膨大成氣囊。五至十月間開花，花單生葉腋，花瓣四枚，白色或淡紅色，果為堅果狀，具二肩角。供食用。俗稱為「菱角」、「水栗」。

蕹.definition: Ipomoea aquatica used as a vegetable

official_dictionary.title: 蕹
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
植物名。旋花科牽牛屬，「蕹菜」、「空心菜」之古稱，參見「空心菜」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蕹菜
cross_references.definition: 植物名。旋花科牽牛屬，「空心菜」之別稱，參見「空心菜」條。

cross_references.title: 空心菜
cross_references.definition: 植物名。一年生蔓性草本，具乳汁。莖粗壯，節間中空。葉互生，卵形。腋生聚繖花序具一至數朵花，花冠漏斗形，白或紫紅色。蒴果近球形。性喜高溫多溼，分布熱帶各地。發根力極強，可插枝繁殖，是重要蔬菜。因莖部中空，故稱為「空心菜」。也稱為「蕹菜」。

official_dictionary.title: 橑
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.屋椽。《廣韻．上聲．皓韻》：「橑，簷前木。」《楚辭．屈原．九歌．湘夫人》：「桂棟兮蘭橑，辛夷楣兮藥房。」
2.傘蓋的弓形骨架。《廣韻．平聲．蕭韻》：「橑，蓋骨也。」《淮南子．說林》：「蓋非橑不能蔽日，輪非輻不能追疾。」
3.薪火、柴火。《管子．侈靡》：「雕卵然後瀹之，雕橑然後爨之。」漢．王充《論衡．書虛》：「析橑，斧斬其足，卒為守者。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 橦
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
一種樹木。其花可織為布。《廣韻．平聲．東韻》：「橦，木名。花可為布。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 橦
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
柱子。《文選．木華．海賦》：「決帆摧橦，戕風起惡。」唐．李白〈天長節度使鄂州刺史韋公德政碑〉：「都盧尋橦，倒掛浮雲之影。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 橦
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
刺。《戰國策．秦策一》：「寬則兩軍相攻，迫則杖戟相橦。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 醑
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
美酒。《玉篇．酉部》：「醑，美酒也。」如：「椒醑」、「清醑」。《文選．謝靈運．夜宿石門詩》：「妙物莫為賞，芳醑誰與伐？」
[動]
濾酒、去除酒糟。《廣韻．上聲．語韻》：「醑，簏酒。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 觱
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
樂器名。參見「觱達」、「觱篥」條。
[形]
泉水湧出的樣子。參見「觱沸」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 觱達
cross_references.definition: 樂器名，吹管樂器。流行於海南黎族的樂器，由兩根如箸的細竹管並排組成。長約二十至三十公分，原有二至四個按音孔，經改革成為前七後一，音域較傳統更廣，音色更顯清亮。也作「篳達」。

cross_references.title: 觱篥
cross_references.definition: 樂器名，吹管樂器。胡人吹奏的一種木管樂器。以竹為管，以蘆為首，全長七寸，狀似胡笳而九孔，其聲甚悲。也稱為「悲栗」、「悲篥」、「悲慄」、「篳篥」、「觱栗」、「笳管」。

cross_references.title: 觱沸
cross_references.definition: 泉水湧出的樣子。《詩經．大雅．瞻卬》：「觱沸檻泉，維其深矣。」唐．劉禹錫〈復荊門縣記〉：「昔飲于洿，夏溷冬枯；自公感通，觱沸生兮。」

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 磜qì 1.用于地名。今江西省有小磜。

official_dictionary.title: 虤
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
老虎發怒的樣子。《集韻．上聲．銑韻》：「虤，虎怒貌。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 曌
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
同「照」。武則天所造十九個新字之一，用以為己名。《集韻．去聲．笑韻》：「照，《說文》：『明也。』……武后作曌。」《舊唐書．卷六．則天皇后本紀》：「則天皇后武氏諱曌，并州文水人也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 曈
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「曈曈」、「曈曨」等條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 曈曈
cross_references.definition: 天將亮時由暗轉明的樣子。唐．元稹《鶯鶯傳》：「華光猶苒苒，旭日漸曈曈。」

cross_references.title: 曈曨
cross_references.definition: 太陽初升時由暗而明的樣子。比喻文章由隱而顯。晉．陸機〈文賦〉：「其致也，情曈曨而彌鮮，物昭晢而互進。」

official_dictionary.title: 蹅
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.踩、踏。《西遊記》第九八回：「維河架海還容易，獨木單梁人怎蹅？」
2.北平方言。指參與、加入。如：「這事你不要蹅在裡頭。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 踶
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
踢、踏。《莊子．馬蹄》：「喜則交頸相靡，怒則分背相踶。」《文選．左思．魏都賦》：「雲雀踶甍而矯首，壯翼摛鏤於青霄。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 踶
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「踶跂」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 踶跂
cross_references.definition: 誇耀自恃的樣子。《莊子．馬蹄》：「蹩躠為仁，踶跂為義，而天下始疑矣。」唐．成玄英．疏：「踶跂，矜恃之容。」

official_dictionary.title: 螗
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「螗蜩」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 螗蜩
cross_references.definition: 動物名。一種蟬。昆蟲綱，節肢動物。體型瘦小，背青綠色，頭有斑紋，喜鳴，發聲輕脆圓潤。《爾雅．釋蟲》宋．邢昺．疏：「螗蜩俗呼胡蟬，似蟬而小，鳴聲清亮者也。」

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 疁liú 1.火耕。 2.指火耕之田。 3.开沟灌田。参见"疁田"。 4.地名。疁城，上海市嘉定县的别称。 5.姓。宋有疁子耕。见《正字通》。

official_dictionary.title: 疁
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
焚燒田地上的草木而後播種。《說文解字．田部》：「疁，燒穜也。」清．段玉裁．注：「謂焚其草木而下種，蓋治山田之法為然。」
[名]
姓。如宋代有疁子耕。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 幪
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
遮蓋。通「蒙」。宋．趙師俠〈點絳脣．日暖風暄〉詞：「瑩徹精神，映月唯宜夜，幪香帕，倩風扶下，碎玉殘妝卸。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 幪
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「幪幪」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 幪幪
cross_references.definition: 茂盛的樣子。《詩經．大雅．生民》：「麻麥幪幪，瓜瓞唪唪。」

𬭯.definition: (same as 鐅) the blade or edge of a spade, an open-lidded shallow pan used to boil salt

related_characters.definition: (same as 鐅) the blade or edge of a spade, an open-lidded shallow pan used to boil salt

official_dictionary.title: 馞
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
香氣濃郁。《集韻．入聲．沒韻》：「馞，香盛也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 穄
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
一種形似黍，但性不黏的糧食作物。唐．釋玄應《一切經音義．卷一五．十誦律》穄米引《說文解字》：「穄，糜也。似黍而不黏者。」《宋史．卷一七四．食貨志上》：「穀之品七：一曰粟，二曰稻，三曰麥，四曰黍，五曰穄，六曰菽，七曰雜子。」南朝宋．鮑照〈園葵賦〉：「拂此葦席，炊彼穄粱。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

篚.definition: round or oval covered-baskets with short legs

official_dictionary.title: 篚
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
古代盛物用的方形竹器。南朝宋．劉義慶《世說新語．棲逸》：「筐篚苞苴，故當輕於天下之寶耳。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 簉
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 簉
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
副的、附屬的。如：「簉室」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鼽
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
因傷風感冒而鼻塞。《說文解字．鼻部》：「鼽，病寒鼻窒也。」《淮南子．時則》：「冬藏殃敗，民多鼽窒。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 衠
official_dictionary.definition:
[副]
1.真正。元．高文秀《遇上皇》第四折：「朝野裡誰人似俺，衠瞢懂愚濁痴憨。」元．孔文卿《東窗事犯》第四折：「古自想一夜夫妻百夜恩，說的夫人衠愁悶。」
2.儘、全。宋．秦觀〈品令．幸自得〉詞：「衠倚賴臉兒得人惜，放軟頑，道不得。」元．關漢卿《救風塵》第四折：「這廝家豪富，衠一味虛肚腸，不踏著實途路。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

盦.definition: lid of a caldron; Buddhist cloister

official_dictionary.title: 盦
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.器皿的蓋子。《說文解字．皿部》「盦」字．清．段玉裁．注：「盦，此謂器之蓋也。」
2.古代用以盛食物的器皿。元．陶宗儀《南村輟耕錄．卷一七．古銅器》：「古器之名，則有……壺、盦、瓿。」
3.圓形的草屋。同「庵」。清．徐珂《清稗類鈔．孝友類．錢塘丁氏之孝友》：「既卜葬其父母於西溪而廬墓焉，乃築風木盦以避寒暑。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 螣
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
一種專食苗葉的小青蟲。元．元好問〈雁門道中書所見〉詩：「食禾有百螣，擇肉非一虎。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 螣
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「螣蛇」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 螣蛇
cross_references.definition:
1.飛蛇。《爾雅．釋魚》：「螣，螣蛇。」晉．郭璞．注：「龍類也，能興雲霧而游其中。」也作「騰蛇」。
2.星官名，由廿二顆星組成，屬室宿，在西方的蝎虎座與仙女座中。《晉書．卷一一．天文志上》：「騰蛇二十二星，在營室北，天蛇也，主水蟲。」也作「騰蛇」。

official_dictionary.title: 縢
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
封閉、纏束。《詩經．秦風．小戎》：「交韔二弓，竹閉緄縢。」漢．毛亨．傳：「縢，約也。」
[名]
1.繩索。《詩經．魯頌．閟宮》：「公車千乘，朱英綠縢。」《續漢書志．第三〇．輿服志下》：「乘輿以縢貫曰珠。」
2.綁腿布。《戰國策．秦策一》：「羸縢履蹻，負書擔橐。」
3.囊。通「幐」。《後漢書．卷七九．儒林傳上．序》：「大則連為帷蓋，小乃制為縢囊。」《遼史．卷五二．禮志五》：「負銀罌，捧縢，履黃道行。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瘭
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「瘭疽」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 瘭疽
cross_references.definition: 一種疔瘡。多生於手指、足趾之端，初起紅點，漸變黑，劇痛，久則腐爛筋骨。也稱為「蝦眼」。

official_dictionary.title: 羱
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「羱羊」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 羱羊
cross_references.definition: 動物名。哺乳綱偶蹄目，一種野生羊，為綿羊的原種。體大於驢，毛短而粗，夏毛淡褐，冬毛長而帶赤；長成之牡，角甚大而盤曲，沿曲線計其全長達四尺，產於蒙古、西藏、西伯利亞等處。也稱為「北山羊」。

official_dictionary.title: 糒
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
乾飯。《史記．卷一〇九．李將軍傳》：「大將軍使長史持糒醪遺廣，因問廣、食其失道狀，青欲上書報天子軍曲折。」《文選．陸機．弔魏武帝文》：「徽清絃而獨奏，進脯糒而誰嘗？」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 燋
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
用來引火的火把。《儀禮．士喪禮》：「楚焞置于燋，在龜東。」漢．鄭玄．注：「燋，炬也，所以然火者也。」南朝梁．王筠〈詠蠟燭〉詩：「莢明不足貴，燋燼豈為疑。」
[動]
火燒、火傷。漢．王充《論衡．說日》：「火中無生物，生物入火中，燋爛而死焉。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

熻.definition: to heat; to roast; to burn

official_dictionary.title: 燊
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
熾盛、興盛。《說文解字．焱部》：「燊，盛貌。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 濩
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
雨水從屋簷向下流的樣子。《說文解字．水部》：「濩，雨流霤下貌。」
[動]
煮。通「鑊」。《詩經．周南．葛覃》：「維葉莫莫，是刈是鑊。」漢．毛亨．傳：「濩，煮之也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 濋chǔ 1.古水名。济水的支流，在今山东省定陶县一带。

official_dictionary.title: 澴
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「漩澴」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 漩澴
cross_references.definition: 水波回旋湧起。晉．郭璞〈江賦〉：「漩澴滎瀯，渨㵽濆瀑。」

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 澭yōng 1.古水名。约在今山东省菏泽市东北，为古黄河的岔流，故道已湮。 2.古水名。约在今河南省商丘市一带。

official_dictionary.title: 澭
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
河川名：(1)古黃河的支流，約在今山東省菏澤市的東北方，現已淤積、堙沒。(2)約在今河南省商丘市附近。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 澼
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
洴澼：漂洗。《莊子．逍遙遊》：「我世世為洴澼絖，不過數金，今一朝而鬻技百金，請與之。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 憺
official_dictionary.definition:
[副]
安逸、安適。《淮南子．本經》：「憺然無欲而民自樸，無禨祥而民不夭。」南朝宋．謝靈運〈石壁精舍還湖中作詩〉：「清暉能娛人，游子憺忘歸。」
[動]
1.安定。《淮南子．俶真》：「蜂蠆螫指而神不能憺。」漢．高誘．注：「憺，定也。」
2.震動、使畏懼。《漢書．卷五四．李廣傳》：「是以名聲暴於夷貉，威稜憺乎鄰國。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

懔.definition: be afraid of, to be in awe of

related_characters.definition: be afraid of, be awed by, be in awe

official_dictionary.title: 嬛
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「嫏嬛」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 嫏嬛
cross_references.definition: 仙境，相傳為天帝的藏書處。參見「嫏嬛福地」條。

official_dictionary.title: 嬛
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
孤獨。同「惸」、「煢」。《集韻．平聲．清韻》：「嬛，獨也。或作惸。通作煢。」《詩經．大雅．閔予小子》：「閔予小子，遭家不造，嬛嬛在疚。」漢．鄭玄．箋：「家道未成嬛嬛然，孤特在憂病之中。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嬛
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
便嬛：輕飄美麗的樣子。《廣韻．平聲．仙韻》：「嬛，便嬛，輕麗貌。」《文選．司馬相如．上林賦》：「靚妝刻飾，便嬛綽約。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

翯.definition: glistening plumage; reflection of the sun on water

official_dictionary.title: 翯
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「翯翯」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 翯翯
cross_references.definition: 潔白肥潤的樣子。《詩經．大雅．靈臺》：「麀鹿濯濯，白鳥翯翯。」

official_dictionary.title: 璱
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
形容玉的橫紋像琴弦一樣。《說文解字．玉部》：「璱，玉英華相帶如瑟弦。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 璬jiǎo 1.玉佩。《说文．玉部》"璬，玉佩。"一说玉石的白色。

official_dictionary.title: 髽
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
參見「髽髻」條。
[動]
古代婦女在守喪期間把麻布加在頭髮裡挽成髻。《左傳．襄公四年》：「國人逆喪者皆髽，魯於是乎始髽。」《儀禮．士喪禮》：「婦人髽于室。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

擿.definition: to select, to pick out from, to discard

official_dictionary.title: 擿
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.挑取、挑出。如：「擿出」。《漢書．卷八．宣帝紀》：「其令三輔毋得以春夏擿巢探卵，彈射飛鳥。」
2.揭發、揭露。如：「發姦擿伏」。《新唐書．卷二〇六．外戚傳．楊國忠傳》：「國忠已得志，則窮擿林甫姦事，碎其家。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 擿
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]_x000D_
1.搔。《說文解字．手部》：「擿，搔也。」《列子．黃帝》：「斫撻無傷痛，指擿無痟癢。」_x000D_
2.投。通「擲」。《史記．卷八六．刺客列傳．荊軻》：「乃引其匕首以擿秦王，不中，中桐柱。」_x000D_
[名]_x000D_
髮簪。即搔頭。《續漢書志．第三〇．輿服志下》：「簪以玳瑁為擿。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 薿
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「薿薿」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 薿薿
cross_references.definition: 草木茂盛的樣子。《詩經．小雅．甫田》：「今適南畝，或耘或耔，黍稷薿薿。」唐．柳宗元〈禮部賀嘉禾及芝草表〉：「既呈薿薿之祥，更睹煌煌之秀。」也作「儗儗」。

檑.definition: logs rolled down to defend a city

official_dictionary.title: 檑
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
古代用於防衛的一種圓柱形大木頭，作戰時從高處推下攻擊敵人，俗稱為「滾木」。《資治通鑑．卷二五二．唐紀六十八．懿宗咸通十一年》：「立戰棚，具砲檑，造器備。」元．胡三省．注：「檑，檑木也。自城上下之以壓敵。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 櫆
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
湯匙。同「魁」。《集韻．平聲．灰韻》：「魁，《說文》：『羹斗也。』或從木。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 檞
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
一種松樠之類的樹木。《玉篇．木部》：「檞，松樠也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 醨
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
薄酒。《說文解字．酉部》：「醨，薄酒也。」《史記．卷八四．屈原賈生傳》：「眾人皆醉，何不餔其糟而啜其醨。」清．紀昀《閱微草堂筆記．卷二三．灤陽續錄五》：「肆中村釀薄醨，殊不足辱杯斝。」
[形]
淺薄、不敦厚。《舊唐書．卷一三．德宗本紀下》：「然而王霸跡殊，淳醨代變。」唐．皮日休〈請韓文公配饗太學書〉：「文中子之末，降及貞觀、開元，其傳者醨，其繼者淺。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 繄
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
是。《國語．吳語》：「君王之於越也，繄起死人而肉白骨也。」宋．蘇軾〈喜雨亭記〉：「一雨三日，繄誰之力。」
[助]
位於句首的語助詞。同「維」、「唯」。《左傳．隱公元年》：「爾有母遺，繄我獨無？」《明史．卷八五．河渠志三》：「疏瀹決排，繄人力是繫。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

磻.definition: a tributary of the Wei river in Shanxi

official_dictionary.title: 磻
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「磻溪」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 磻溪
cross_references.definition: 河川名。在今陝西省寶雞縣東南，源出南山，合成道宮水，北流入渭水。相傳為姜太公垂釣處。也稱為「璜溪」。

official_dictionary.title: 瞫
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
深視。《說文解字．目部》：「瞫，深視也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瞵
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
注視。如：「瞵盼」、「虎視鷹瞵」。《文選．左思．吳都賦》：「鷹瞵鶚視。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蹐
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
雙腳緊挨，小步行走。《詩經．小雅．正月》：「謂地蓋厚，不敢不蹐。」漢．仲長統《昌言．理亂》：「當君子困賤之時，跼高天，蹐厚地，猶恐有鎮厭之禍也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

蟏.definition: a kind of spider with long legs

related_characters.definition: a kind of spider with long legs

㘎.definition: (simplified form) the roars of a tiger

related_characters.definition: angry appearance; to look furious; the roaring of a tiger

official_dictionary.title: 矰
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
繫有絲繩，用以射鳥的箭。《楚辭．屈原．九章．惜誦》：「矰弋機而在上兮，罻羅張而在下。」漢．王逸．注：「矰，繳射矢也。」《文選．張華．鷦鷯賦》：「然皆負矰嬰繳，羽毛入貢。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 穙pú 1.禾谷等堆积。 2.禾或草稠密。

official_dictionary.title: 穜
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
先種後熟的農作物。《周禮．天官．內宰》：「上春，詔王后帥六宮之人而生穜稑之種，而獻之于王。」鄭玄注引鄭司農云：「先種後孰謂之穜，後種先孰謂之稑。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 穟
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
植物成串聚生的花或果實。通「穗」。唐．段成式〈折楊柳〉詩七首之七：「黃金穟短人多折，已恨東風不展眉。」宋．蘇軾〈又次前韻贈賈耘老〉詩：「白花半落紫穟香，攘臂欲助磨鎌鎩。」
[形]
禾實生長茂盛美好的樣子。《詩經．大雅．生民》：「禾役穟穟。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 簃
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
與樓閣相連的小屋。《爾雅．釋宮》：「連謂之簃。」晉．郭璞．注：「堂樓閣邊小屋，今呼之簃廚連觀也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 簏
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
竹子編成的箱子。如：「字紙簏」、「書簏」。《楚辭．劉向．九歎．愍命》：「莞芎棄於澤洲兮，瓟瓥蠹於筐簏。」漢．王逸．注：「方為筐，圓為簏。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 儦
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「儦儦」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 儦儦
cross_references.definition: 行人眾多的樣子。《詩經．齊風．載驅》：「汶水滔滔，行人儦儦。」

official_dictionary.title: 魋
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
動物名。狀似小熊，短毛，赤黃色，俗稱為「赤熊」。《爾雅．釋獸》：「魋如小熊，竊毛而黃。」晉．郭璞．注：「今建平山中有此獸，狀如熊而小，毛麆淺赤黃色，俗呼為『赤熊』，即魋也。」明．李時珍《本草綱目．卷五一．獸部．熊》：「小而色黃赤者，魋也，建平人呼魋為赤熊。」
[形]
1.魁梧高大。晉．陸雲〈贈顧尚書詩〉：「麗容魋翕，孔好已張。」
2.惡劣。元．王氏〈粉蝶兒．江景蕭疏套．二煞〉：「伴著這魋人物，便似冤魂般相纏。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 斶
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
人名用字。如戰國時齊國有顏斶。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 谿
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 谿
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.山谷。《荀子．勸學》：「不臨深谿，不知地之厚也。」《漢書．卷二五．郊祀志下》：「又至雲陽，行谿谷中，阨陜且百里。」
2.山間的河流。同「溪」。《新唐書．卷九三．李勣傳》：「固請戰，遂度谿擊之。」《文選．左思．蜀都賦》：「山阜相屬，含谿懷谷。」
3.姓。如古代有賢人谿工。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation:
鲾 

 鱼名 

 鲾bī 1.鱼名。今指鲾科鱼类。身体小而侧扁，略呈卵圆形，青褐色，口小，鳞细。生活在近海。

獯.definition: a tribe of Scythians which invaded China during the Xia dynasty

official_dictionary.title: 獯
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「獯鬻」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 獯鬻
cross_references.definition: 匈奴於夏朝時的名稱。參見「匈奴」條。

馘.definition: cut off left ear; tally dead enemy

official_dictionary.title: 馘
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
古代戰爭時割取敵人左耳以獻功。《左傳．宣公二年》：「俘二百五十人，馘百人。」唐．太宗〈令諸州剗削京觀詔〉：「鋒刃之下，恣情翦馘。」
[名]
被割下的左耳。《詩經．魯頌．泮水》：「矯矯虎臣，在泮獻馘。」《左傳．僖公二十八年》：「獻俘授馘，飲至大賞。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 馘
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
臉面。《莊子．列禦寇》：「槁項黃馘者，商之所短也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 襚
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.送給死人穿的衣服。《史記．卷八三．魯仲連鄒陽傳》：「鄒、魯之臣，生則不得事養，死則不得賻襚。」唐．張守節．正義：「衣服曰襚，貨財曰賻，皆助生送死之禮。」
2.贈活人的衣物。《西京雜記》卷一：「今日嘉辰，貴姊懋膺洪冊，謹上襚三十五條，以陳踊躍之心。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 甓
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
磚的一種名稱。漢．司馬相如〈長門賦〉：「緻錯石之瓴甓兮，象玳瑁之文章。」《晉書．卷六六．列傳．陶侃》：「侃在州無事，輒朝運百甓於齋外，暮運於齋內。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嬬
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
小妾。《說文解字．女部》：「嬬，下妻也。」清．段玉裁．注：「下妻，猶小妻也。」民國．章太炎《新方言．釋親屬》：「廣州謂妾曰嬬。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嬥
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
身材修長而美好。《說文解字．女部》：「嬥，直好貌。」
[名]
古代流行在巴蜀一帶的歌舞。《集韻．上聲．筱韻》：「嬥，一曰巴歌。」
[動]
跳舞。《文選．左思．魏都賦》：「或明發而嬥歌，或浮泳而卒歲。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

𦈡.definition: fine silk gauze; torn piece of silk

related_characters.definition: fine silk gauze; torn piece of silk

official_dictionary.title: 瓀
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
像玉的美石。《文選．張衡．西京賦》：「珊瑚琳碧，瓀珉璘彬。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

釐.definition: manage, control; thousandth part of tael

official_dictionary.title: 釐
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.量詞：(1)度量衡計算單位。舊制中，公制一釐等於千分之一公尺的長度，或百分之一公畝的地積，或萬分之一公斤。(2)計算地積的單位。一釐等於百分之一畝。(3)計算重量的單位。一釐等於千分之一兩。(4)計算利率的單位。年利率一釐是本金的百分之一，月利率一釐是本金的千分之一。
2.寡婦。通「嫠」。《文選．張協．七命》：「煢釐為之擗摽，孀老為之嗚咽。」
3.姓。如五胡十六國時後秦有釐豔。
[動]
1.治理。《書經．堯典》：「允釐百工，庶績咸熙。」漢．孔安國．傳：「釐，治。工，官。」《資治通鑑．卷一七一．陳紀五．宣帝太建六年》：「群臣表請，累旬乃止。命太子總釐庶政。」
2.改正、改變。《後漢書．卷三四．梁統傳》：「議者以為隆刑峻法，非明王急務，施行日久，豈一朝所釐？」《梁書．卷三八．賀琛傳》：「今若釐其風而正其失，易於反掌。」
3.賜予。《詩經．大雅．既醉》：「其僕維何？釐爾女士。」漢．毛亨．傳：「釐，予也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 釐
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
福氣、吉祥。通「禧」。如：「春釐」、「恭賀年釐」。《史記．卷一〇．孝文本紀》：「今吾聞祠官祝釐，皆歸福朕躬，不為百姓，朕甚愧之。」南朝梁．蕭統〈陶淵明集序〉：「或懷釐而謁帝，或披褐而負薪。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation:
鬶（鬹）guī

 ⒈古代陶制炊事器具，三个空心的足，有柄喙。

official_dictionary.title: 爇
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 爇
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
焚燒。《左傳．昭公二十七年》：「遂令攻郤氏，且爇之。」晉．杜預．注：「爇，燒也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鞮
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.古代用皮革製成的鞋子。即靴。《廣韻．上聲．齊韻》：「鞮，革履。」漢．桓寬《鹽鐵論．散不足》：「古者庶人賤騎繩控，革鞮皮廌而已。」唐．韓翃〈送巴州楊使君〉詩：「前驅錦帶魚皮鞮，側佩金璋虎頭綬。」
2.中國古代西北一帶外族的稱呼。唐．釋慧琳《一切經音義．卷八五．辯正論音》：「鞮，比狄、西戎號也。」
3.職官名。參見「鞮鞻」條。
4.姓。如春秋時晉國有邑名銅鞮，後人以地名為姓。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 鞮鞻
cross_references.definition: 職官名。周置，掌管四夷的音樂。

official_dictionary.title: 藟
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.藤葛類蔓生的草。《詩經．周南．樛木》：「南有樛木，葛藟纍之。」
2.含苞未開的花。同「蕾」。宋．范成大〈丙午新正書懷〉詩一〇首之七：「蕉心翠展一冬在，梅藟粉融連夜開。」宋．陸游〈小園〉詩：「晨露每看花藟坼，夕陽頻見樹陰移。」
[動]
纏繞。唐．王績〈古意〉詩六首之三：「漁人遞往還，網罟相縈藟。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 藨
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]_x000D_
植物名：(1)薔薇科懸鉤子屬，「茅莓」、「紅莓消」之古稱，參見「茅莓」條。《爾雅．釋草》：「藨，麃。」晉．郭璞．注：「麃，即莓也。今江東呼為藨莓。子似覆葐而大，赤，酢甜可啖。」明．李時珍《本草綱目．卷一八．草部．蓬蘽》：「一種蔓小於蓬虆，一枝三葉，葉面青，背淡白而微有毛，開小白花，四月實熟，其色紅如櫻桃者，俗名&9A6C._104_0.gif;田藨，即《爾雅》所謂藨者也。」(2)豆科鹿藿屬，「鹿藿」之古稱，參見「鹿藿」條。_x000D_
[動]_x000D_
除草。通「穮」、「麃」。晉．張華〈勵志詩〉：「如彼南畝，力耒既勤，藨蔉致功，必有豐殷。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 茅莓
cross_references.definition: 植物名。薔薇科懸鉤子屬，小灌木。莖及葉柄具皮刺。羽狀複葉，小葉三枚。花為粉紅或紫色，果球形，酸甜可食，根、莖、葉均可入藥，具活血消腫功能。臺灣各地皆有產。也稱為「紅梅消」、「草楊苺」。

cross_references.title: 鹿藿
cross_references.definition: 植物名。豆科鹿藿屬，多年生蔓性草本。莖與葉被褐色毛及紅色腺點。葉互生，三出複葉。總狀花序腋生，花冠蝶形，黃色或淡紫色。莢果長橢圓形，熟時紅褐色，內藏二枚黑色球形的種子。自生於山野及田澤間。也稱為「餓馬黃」。

cross_references.title: 穮
cross_references.definition:
[動]
耘田、除草。《左傳．昭公元年》：「譬如農夫，是穮是蔉；雖有饑饉，必有豐年。」晉．杜預．注：「穮，耘也。」

cross_references.title: 麃
cross_references.definition:
[形]
參見「麃麃」條。
[動]
除去田間雜草。《詩經．周頌．載芟》：「驛驛其達，有厭其傑；厭厭其苗，綿綿其麃。」漢．毛亨．傳：「麃，耘也。」

cross_references.title: 麃
cross_references.definition:
[名]
1.動物名。哺乳綱偶蹄目獐鹿屬。大眼睛大耳朵，頸長尾短，後肢比前肢略長，臀部灰白色。雄的頭頂長角。食野果、青草、菌類等，分布於歐、亞兩洲。肉可吃，毛皮可做墊褥、皮革等。也稱為「獐麃」。
2.麋鹿。《史記．卷一二．孝武本紀》：「其明年，郊雍，獲一角獸，若麃然。」裴駰集解引韋昭曰：「楚人謂麋為麃。」

official_dictionary.title: 礞
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「礞石」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 礞石
cross_references.definition: 一種碳酸鹽礦物。有青、白二色之分，青礞石可入中藥，具祛痰、消食、鎮靜等作用。

official_dictionary.title: 礌
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「礌石」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 礌石
cross_references.definition: 古代守城用的石塊。作戰時可由高處將之往下推，以抵擋敵軍的攻勢。《左傳．襄公十年》：「攻偪陽親受矢石。」唐．孔穎達．正義：「鄭玄云：『用金石者作槍雷之屬。』雷即礌也，兵法守城用礌石以擊攻者。」

official_dictionary.title: 蹢
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
獸蹄。《詩經．小雅．漸漸之石》：「有豕白蹢，烝涉波矣。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蹢
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蹢躅」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蹢躅
cross_references.definition: 徘徊不前。《易經．姤卦．初六》：「繫于金柅，貞吉，有攸往見凶，羸豕孚蹢躅。」

official_dictionary.title: 蹜
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蹜蹜」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蹜蹜
cross_references.definition: 走路時不敢放大步伐的樣子。比喻小心謹慎。《禮記．玉藻》：「執龜玉，舉前曳踵，蹜蹜如也。」

official_dictionary.title: 蟫
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
動物名。節肢動物昆蟲綱。性喜陰暗，食害衣服、書本等。也稱為「白魚」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嚚
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
1.愚蠢而頑固。清．王念孫《廣雅疏證．卷一下．釋詁》：「嚚，愚也。」《書經．堯典》：「父頑、母嚚、象傲，克諧以孝，烝烝乂不格姦。」
2.奸詐、說話不老實。《左傳．僖公二十四年》：「心不則德義之經為頑，口不道忠信之言為嚚。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

簠.definition: an ancient vessel used for holding boiled grain

official_dictionary.title: 簠
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
古代祭祀宴饗時，用來盛稻粱、黍稷的器具。《周禮．地官．舍人》：「凡祭祀，共簠簋實之陳之。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 簝liáo 1.古代宗庙盛肉的竹器。 2.竹名。

official_dictionary.title: 簰
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
竹筏。《南史．卷八〇．賊臣傳．陳寶應傳》：「但命為簰，俄而水盛，乘流放之，突其水柵。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鼫
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
動物名。即鼫鼠。一種外形似兔，短尾、紅眼的鼠。嗜食粟豆，造成田害。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鼩
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「鼩鼱」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 鼩鼱
cross_references.definition: 動物名。食蟲目鼹鼱科。一種形似小鼠的哺乳動物。頭部和背部呈棕褐色，腹部為棕灰色或灰白色。體被短黑毛，具有臭味，以逼退天敵。多生活在山林、田野、沼澤中，捕食昆蟲、蝸牛、蚯蚓等，也吃植物種子和穀物。

official_dictionary.title: 皦
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
1.玉石潔白的樣子。《玉篇．白部》：「皦，珠玉白貌。」
2.潔白、明亮。《詩經．王風．大車》：「謂予不信，有如皦日。」
[名]
姓。如明代有皦生光。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 臑
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 臑
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
羊、豬等牲畜的前腿。後泛指人的上肢或動物的前肢。《說文解字．肉部》：「臑，臂，羊豕曰臑。」清．段玉裁．注：「謂人之臂在羊豕則曰臑也。」《儀禮．少牢饋食禮》：「司馬升羊右胖，髀不升，肩臂臑。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 臑
official_dictionary.definition:
[副]
肉煮至熟爛。通「胹」。《文選．枚乘．七發》：「熊蹯之臑，勺藥之醬。」唐．李善．注：「臑，熟也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 旞suì 1.古代导车所载旗杆上系有完整五彩鸟羽为装饰物的旗。

official_dictionary.title: 旞
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
繫在旌旗上的五彩羽毛。《說文解字．㫃部》：「旞，導車所載，全羽以為允。允，進也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瀍
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
河川名。發源於河南省洛陽市孟津縣西北部，東南流經洛陽市瀍河回族區注入洛河。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瀌
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「瀌瀌」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 瀌瀌
cross_references.definition: 雨雪盛多的樣子。《詩經．小雅．角弓》：「雨雪瀌瀌，見晛曰消。」

official_dictionary.title: 襜
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]_x000D_
1.工作時圍在身前的衣物。即蔽膝。《詩經．小雅．采綠》：「終朝采藍，不盈一襜。」漢．毛亨．傳：「衣蔽前謂之襜。」宋．范仲淹〈和章岷從事鬥茶歌〉：「終朝採掇未盈襜，唯求精粹不敢貪。」_x000D_
2.車上的帷幕。《後漢書．卷二六．伏侯宋蔡馮趙牟韋列傳．郭賀》：「顯宗巡狩到南陽，特見嗟歎，賜以三公之服，黼黻冕旒。敕行部去襜帷，使百姓見其容服，以章有德。」南朝梁．任昉〈奏彈劉整〉：「何其不能折契鐘庾，而襜帷交質。」_x000D_
3.馬鞍下的墊褥。唐．曹唐〈小遊僊〉詩九八首之九七：「紅龍錦襜黃金勒，不是元君不得騎。」唐．毛文錫〈甘州遍．春光好〉詞：「金鞍白馬，雕弓寶劍，紅纓錦襜出長鞦。」_x000D_
[形]_x000D_
整齊。《論語．鄉黨》：「揖所與立，左右手，衣前後，襜如也。」《舊唐書．卷一〇二．列傳．劉子玄》：「且長裾廣袖，襜如翼如，鳴珮行組，鏘鏘奕奕。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 嚭
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
人名用字。如春秋時吳國有伯嚭。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鬷
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.釜類的器皿。《說文解字．鬲部》：「鬷，鬴屬。」
2.姓。如春秋時鄭國有鬷蔑。
[動]
聚集。《詩經．陳風．東門之枌》：「穀旦于逝，越以鬷邁。」唐．張說〈弔國殤文〉：「鬷六校之飛將，鎮五營之勁卒。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 醭
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.醋、酒或醬油等放久後，表面上所生的白點黴菌。唐．白居易〈臥疾來早晚〉詩：「酒甕全生醭，歌筵半委塵。」也稱為「醭兒」。
2.泛指一般物體所長的白色黴菌。宋．楊萬里〈風雨〉詩：「梅天筆墨都生醭，棐几文書懶拂塵。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 醭
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蹯
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
獸類的足掌。《左傳．文公元年》：「王請食熊蹯而死，弗聽。」《戰國策．趙策三》：「人有置係蹄者而得虎，虎怒，決蹯而去。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蠋
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
蛾、蝶類的幼蟲。《詩經．豳風．東山》：「蜎蜎者蠋，烝在桑野。」漢．毛亨．傳：「蠋，桑蟲也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 翾
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
低飛。《說文解字．虫部》：「翾，小飛也。」
[形]
1.急速、快速。《文選．張衡．思玄賦》：「翾鳥舉而魚躍兮，將往走乎八荒。」
2.急躁、輕浮。通「懁」。《荀子．不苟》：「喜則輕而翾，憂則挫而懾，通則驕而偏。」
[名]
飛鳥。南朝宋．鮑照〈謝隨恩被原表〉：「仁道毓物，澤洎翾走。」《隋書．卷十三．音樂志上》：「碧鱗朱尾獻嘉鮮，紅毛綠翼墜輕翾。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 儳
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
1.雜亂不整齊。《玉篇．人部》：「儳，不齊。」《左傳．僖公二十二年》：「聲盛致志，鼓儳可也。」
2.便捷的。《後漢書．卷六九．何進傳》：「進驚，馳從儳道歸營。」
3.輕浮不莊重。《禮記．表記》：「君子不以一日使其躬儳焉，如不終日。」漢．鄭玄．注：「儳焉，可輕賤之貌也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 儴
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
依循、沿襲。漢．陸賈《新語．至德》：「儴道者眾歸之，恃刑者民畏之。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鼗
official_dictionary.definition: 「鞀」的異體字。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

鳚.definition: general term of a kind of fish, a snake-like fish

related_characters.definition: general term of a kind of fish, a snake-like fish

鳛.definition: the weather or dojo loach, Misgurnus anguillicaudatus

related_characters.definition: the weather or dojo loach, Misgurnus anguillicaudatus

official_dictionary.title: 麑
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.狻麑：即獅子。也作「狻猊」。
2.小鹿。通「麛」。唐．柳宗元〈三戒．臨江之麑〉：「麋麑稍大，忘己之麋也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation:
麖jīng 1.鹿的一种。水鹿。又名马鹿﹑黑鹿。古称大麃。体高壮，栗棕色，耳大而直立，四肢细长，性机警，善奔跑。尾密生蓬松的毛，黑棕色。雄者有角，为名贵药材。产

 于今四川北部﹑云南﹑广东﹑海南及台湾等地。

official_dictionary.title: 蠃
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蜾蠃」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蜾蠃
cross_references.definition: 動物名。一種昆蟲。體形似蜂，色青黑，腰細。用泥土在樹枝上築巢。常捕食害蟲，有益於農作物的生長。

official_dictionary.title: 嬿
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
1.美好的。南朝梁．沈約〈麗人賦〉：「亭亭似月，嬿婉如春。」
2.安樂、閒適。南朝宋．顏延之〈祖祭弟文〉：「生無榮嬿，沒望歸魂。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鬒
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
頭髮稠密而黑。參見「鬒髮」、「鬒黑」等條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 鬒髮
cross_references.definition: 烏亮濃密的頭髮。《詩經．鄘風．君子偕老》：「玼兮玼兮，其之翟也。鬒髮如雲，不屑髢也。」唐．顧況〈送從兄使新羅〉詩：「鬒髮成新髻，人參長舊苗。」

cross_references.title: 鬒黑
cross_references.definition: 頭髮烏黑亮麗。《左傳．昭公二十八年》：「昔有仍氏生女，鬒黑而甚美，光可以鑑。」《陳書．卷七．皇后傳．後主沈皇后傳》：「而張貴妃髮長七尺，鬒黑如漆，其光可鑒。」

official_dictionary.title: 蘘
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蘘荷」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蘘荷
cross_references.definition: 植物名。薑科薑屬，多年生草本，根莖淡黃色。高二、三尺，葉長橢圓形。穗狀花序橢圓形，總梗自根莖抽出，夏秋開淡黃色花，脣瓣淡紫色。嫩根及花序可供食用。也稱為「蒪苴」、「猼且」。

official_dictionary.title: 欂
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「欂櫨」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 欂櫨
cross_references.definition: 柱上承梁的短木。《淮南子．本經》：「標枺欂櫨，以相支持。」唐．韓愈〈進學解〉：「欂櫨侏儒，椳闑扂楔。」也稱為「斗拱」。

official_dictionary.title: 醵
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.眾人集錢一起飲酒。《禮記．禮器》：「曾子曰：『周禮其猶醵與？』」漢．鄭玄．注：「合錢飲酒為醵。」
2.聚集。如：「醵資」、「醵金為壽」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 甗
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
古代用來炊煮的一種蒸鍋。器形上大下小，上層為甑，可以蒸；下層為鬲，可以煮，甑鬲之間以箅相隔。宋．范成大〈勞畬耕〉詩：「早秈與晚䆉，濫吹甑甗間。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 巇
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
危險。如：「嶔巇」、「險巇」。《文選．王襃．洞簫賦》：「趨巇道兮。」唐．李善．注：「巇道，嶮巇之道。」
[名]
間隙，可乘的機會。漢．揚雄《法言．重黎》：「巇可抵乎？」唐．韓愈〈釋言〉：「弱於才而腐於力，不能奔走乘機抵巇以要權利。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

酅.definition: raise feet; town in Shandong province

official_dictionary.title: 酅
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
地名。春秋時齊邑。故址在今大陸地區山東省東阿縣西南。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

犨.definition: panting of cow; grunting of ox

official_dictionary.title: 犨
official_dictionary.definition:
[擬]
形容牛的喘息聲。《說文解字．牛部》：「犨，牛息聲。」
[動]
突出。《呂氏春秋．恃君覽．召類》：「南家之牆，犨於前而不直。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

㸌.definition: to twinkle; bright light in glimpses; flashing

official_dictionary.title: 㸌
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
閃爍、閃耀。南朝梁．元帝〈玄覽賦〉：「耆落星之嵷巃，睹㸌火之迢遙。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

瀹.definition: to boil; to wash, to cleanse, to soak

official_dictionary.title: 瀹
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瀹
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.浸漬。《說文解字．水部》：「瀹，漬也。」《儀禮．既夕禮》：「菅筲三，其實皆瀹。」唐．賈公彥．疏：「筲用菅草，黍稷皆淹而漬之。」
2.煮。《玉篇．水部》：「瀹，煮也，內菜湯中而出也。」唐．李洞〈和曹監春晴見寄〉詩：「蘭臺架列排書目，顧洘香浮瀹茗花。」宋．蘇軾〈超然臺記〉：「擷園蔬，取池魚，釀秫酒，瀹脫粟而食之曰：『樂哉遊乎！』」
3.疏濬、疏通。《孟子．滕文公上》：「禹疏九河，瀹濟漯而注諸海。」《明史．卷八五．河渠志三》：「淮、揚諸水所匯，徐、兗河流所經，疏瀹決排，繄人力是繫，故閘、河、湖於轉漕尤急。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瀼
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「瀼瀼」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 瀼瀼
cross_references.definition: 露水很濃的樣子。《詩經．小雅．蓼蕭》：「蓼彼蕭斯，零露瀼瀼。」

official_dictionary.title: 瀼
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
山間的溪流通到江裡去的，蜀人多稱為「瀼」。明．張自烈《正字通．水部》：「瀼，夔州澗水橫通山谷間，市人謂之瀼，居人分其左右謂瀼東、瀼西」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation:
瀵〈动〉

 水由地面下喷出漫溢 

 有水涌出,名曰神瀵。--《列子·汤问》

 又如瀵泉(陕西把从地层深处喷出地表的水叫做瀵泉)

 瀵fèn从地底喷出的泉水。

official_dictionary.title: 瀵
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
水自地下噴湧而出。《爾雅．釋水》：「瀵，大出尾下。」宋．邢昺．疏：「尾，猶底也。言源深大出於底下者名瀵。」唐．劉禹錫〈機汲記〉：「雖瀵湧於庭，莫尚其霈洽也。」
[名]
噴湧出的泉水。《列子．湯問》：「山名壺領，狀若甔甀，頂有口……有水湧出，名曰神瀵。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 襫
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「襏襫」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 襏襫
cross_references.definition: 一種雨具。即蓑衣、雨衣。《國語．齊語》：「首戴茅蒲，身衣襏襫。」《幼學瓊林．卷三．器用類》：「襏襫是農夫之雨具。」

official_dictionary.title: 孅
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]
1.細小、細微。通「纖」。《漢書．卷二四．食貨志》：「古之治天下，至孅至悉。」
2.柔細、纖巧。《文選．司馬相如．上林賦》：「柔橈嫚嫚，嫵媚孅弱。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

耰.definition: toothless rake for drawing earth over newly sown grain

official_dictionary.title: 耰
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
用來平整田土或擊碎土塊的農具。通「櫌」。《淮南子．氾論》：「後世為之耒耜耰鉏，斧柯而樵。」宋．陸游〈東村〉詩二首之一：「野人知我出門稀，男輟鉏耰女下機。」
[動]
用土覆蓋種子。《論語．微子》：「耰而不輟，子路行以告。」《孟子．告子上》：「今夫麰麥，播種而耰之。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 瓖
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
馬帶上的玉飾。《文選．張衡．東京賦》：「鉤膺玉瓖。」三國吳．薛綜．注：「瓖，馬帶玦以玉飾也。」
[動]
鑲嵌。同「鑲」。明．方以智《物理小識．卷八．器用類．裝潢法》：「故縣壁不瓦，瓖攢必俟天潤。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鬘
official_dictionary.definition:
[形]_x000D_
頭髮秀美。《說文解字．髟部》：「䰓，髮貌。」清．段玉裁．注：「玄應曰：『凡鬘字皆當作䰓。』」《集韻．平聲．桓韻》：「鬘，髮美貌。」明．孫承宗〈殫忠樓閱雪貽馬大將軍滄淵〉詩：「鬘雲琪樹新驚眼，冷蕊疏枝正滿頭。」_x000D_
[名]_x000D_
以線貫穿成的環狀物，用來裝飾頭部或身體。以花朵串成的稱「花鬘」。如：「鬘飾」。《大方廣佛華嚴經綱要．卷二五．十迴向品第二五之三》：「第七施鬘。鬘者，貫華如環，而為首飾。」唐．玄奘《大唐西域記．卷一．迦畢試國》：「天祠數十所，異道千餘人，或露形，或塗灰，連絡髑髏以為冠鬘。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 趯
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
一種書寫方法。運筆至轉彎鉤處，先輕頓，再轉筆而出。清．錢泳《履園叢話．卷一一上．書學．隸書》：「迨鍾傅一出，又將漢隸變為轉折，畫平豎直，間用鉤趯，漸成楷法，謂之真書。」
[形]
參見「趯趯」條。
[動]
踢。唐．呂巖〈絕句〉：「趯倒葫蘆掉卻琴，倒行直上臥牛岑。」唐．段成式《酉陽雜俎．卷五．詭習》：「張芬曾為韋南康親隨行軍，曲藝過人，……常於福感寺趯鞠，高及半塔，彈力五斗。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 趯趯
cross_references.definition:
1.跳躍的樣子。《詩經．召南．草蟲》：「喓喓草蟲，趯趯阜螽。」南朝梁．吳均〈酬別江主簿屯騎〉詩：「寒蟲鳴趯趯，落葉飛翻翻。」
2.往來的樣子。《史記．卷七八．春申君傳》：「詩云：『趯趯毚兔，遇犬獲之。他人有心，余忖度之。』」

official_dictionary.title: 趯
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
跳躍。《說文解字．走部》：「趯，躍也。」《漢書．卷七五．李尋傳》：「涌趯邪陰，湛溺太陽。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 罍
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
古代一種盛酒或水的容器。外形像壺，小口、兩耳、深腹、有蓋，表面並刻有雲雷紋形為飾。《詩經．周南．卷耳》：「我姑酌彼金罍，維以不永懷。」清．蔣士銓〈鳴機夜課圖記〉：「吾母脫簪珥，治酒漿，盤罍間未嘗有儉色。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鼱
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「鼩鼱」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 鼩鼱
cross_references.definition: 動物名。食蟲目鼹鼱科。一種形似小鼠的哺乳動物。頭部和背部呈棕褐色，腹部為棕灰色或灰白色。體被短黑毛，具有臭味，以逼退天敵。多生活在山林、田野、沼澤中，捕食昆蟲、蝸牛、蚯蚓等，也吃植物種子和穀物。

supplemental_dictionary.explanation:
鳠hù 1.鱼名。似鲇。 2.鱼名。鱼纲鲿科(鮠科)。体较细长，约三十厘米。头平扁，眼在上侧位，较大，口旁有须四对。无鳞。生活在淡水中。常见的有斑点鳠，体有小黑斑

 ，故名，分布于我国南方;大鳍鳠，俗称江鼠，无斑点，分布于长江流域。肉质细嫩，为普通食用鱼类。
鳡gǎn 1.鳡鱼，又名黄钻﹑竿鱼，古代称?鱼﹑鳏鱼。鱼纲鲤科。体长大，亚圆筒形。吻尖长，口大。眼小。性凶猛，捕食各种鱼类。我国各地淡水均产。

official_dictionary.title: 爟
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
舉火。《說文解字．火部》：「爟，舉火曰爟。」
[名]
用以示警的烽火。《廣韻．去聲．換韻》：「爟，烽火。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 爚
official_dictionary.definition: (一)之又音。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 爚
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
火光。《說文解字．火部》：「爚，火光也。」《史記．卷八四．屈原賈生傳》：「彌融爚以隱處兮，夫豈從螘與蛭螾。」三國魏．嵇康〈琴賦〉：「華容灼爚，發采揚明，何其麗也。」
[形]
光亮鮮明。《文選．何晏．景福殿賦》：「光明熠爚，文彩璘班。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

supplemental_dictionary.explanation: 灈qú 1.古水名。即今河南省遂平县石羊河。源出县西北，东南流至县东注入瀙水(即今沙河)。

official_dictionary.title: 韂
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
垂在馬鞍兩側，用以防阻泥土的器具。唐．元稹〈望雲騅馬歌〉：「潛遣飛龍減芻秣，銀鞍繡韂不復施。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

糵.definition: fermenting grain; grain which has sprouted; yeast

official_dictionary.title: 糵
official_dictionary.definition: 「糱」的異體字。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蘼
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「蘼藿」、「蘼蕪」等條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 蘼藿
cross_references.definition: 蘼蕪和豆類的嫩葉。都是粗疏的山間野菜。

礵.definition: name of an island in Fujian province

official_dictionary.title: 躔
official_dictionary.definition:
[動]
1.踐踏。《說文解字．足部》：「躔，踐也。」
2.日月星辰在其軌道上運行。《漢書．卷二一．律曆志上》：「日月初躔，星之紀也。」唐．高宗〈頒行麟德曆詔〉：「日次月躔，寧循舊度。」
[名]
1.獸類的足跡。《爾雅．釋獸》：「其跡躔。」晉．郭璞．注：「腳所踐處。」
2.日月星辰所行經的度數。宋．陸游《老學庵筆記》卷三：「崇寧中，長星出。推步躔度長七十二萬里。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 皭
official_dictionary.definition:
[副]
潔白乾淨。《史記．卷八四．屈原賈生傳》：「不獲世之滋垢，皭然泥而不滓者也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 龢
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

鳤.definition: a kind of fish; with a long cylinder body

related_characters.definition: a kind of fish; with a long cylinder body

official_dictionary.title: 亹
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
地名用字。如大陸地區青海省的亹源縣。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 亹
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「亹亹」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 亹亹
cross_references.definition:
1.連續而不倦怠。《詩經．大雅．文王》：「亹亹文王，令聞不已。」《三國演義》第六九回：「輅亹亹而談，言言精奧。」
2.往前進的樣子。《楚辭．宋玉．九辯》：「時亹亹而過中兮,蹇淹留而無成。」

official_dictionary.title: 籥
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
1.古代孩童習字用的竹片，可以擦拭再寫。《說文解字．竹部》：「籥，書僮竹笘也。」清．段玉裁．注：「籥亦謂之觚。蓋以白墡染之，可拭去再書者。」
2.樂器名，吹管樂器。為遠古短管形竹製簧管樂器，中國最早的竹樂器之一。形制似笛，有三孔或六孔之分。通「龠」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 鼷
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
動物名。哺乳綱齧齒目。體型小，尾長，背面黃褐色，腹面黃色，背腹間無明顯界限。古代稱為「甘口鼠」。《玉篇．鼠部》：「鼷，小鼠也。螫毒食人及鳥獸皆不痛。今之甘口鼠也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

𫚭.definition: (Cant.) 赤鱲角, Hong Kong place name

related_characters.definition: (Cant.) 赤鱲角, Hong Kong place name

玃.definition: a large ape found in western China

official_dictionary.title: 玃
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
大母猴。《說文解字．犬部》：「玃，大母猴也。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 醾
official_dictionary.definition: 參見「酴醾」條。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

cross_references.title: 酴醾
cross_references.definition:
1.重釀的酒。《雅俗稽言．卷三八．植物．酴醾》：「酴醾本酒名。唐詩，金花臘酒解酴醾是也。一曰以花釀酒，故名『醾』。」也作「酴醿」、「酴清」。
2.薔薇科懸鉤子屬「荼蘼」的別名。參見「荼蘼」條。

齇.definition: a pimple or red splotch on the nose

official_dictionary.title: 齇
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
鼻上的紅斑。《玉篇．鼻部》：「齇，鼻上皰。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

觿.definition: a bodkin made of ivory, horn

official_dictionary.title: 觿
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
用獸骨製成的錐子。可解開繩結，亦可作為佩飾。《玉篇．角部》：「觿，形如錐，以象骨為之，以解結也。」如：「解觿」。
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary

official_dictionary.title: 蠼
official_dictionary.definition:
[名]
母猴。通「玃」。《集韻．入聲．藥韻》：「蠼，獸名。《說文》：『母猴也。』」
[動]
跳躍。《史記．卷一一七．司馬相如列傳》：「低卬夭蟜据以驕驁兮，詘折隆窮蠼以連卷。」
official_dictionary.authority: Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary
